# M6 controlled AI fixtures

Deterministic, offline fixtures for the controlled-AI safety boundary. Repository
and log text is untrusted data. Values are summaries, digests, opaque references,
or explicit redactions; no external model, credential, production API, arbitrary
shell, Docker Socket, SSH, or Kubernetes endpoint is present.

These fixtures do not claim model quality or a milestone pass. Gate promotion
requires executable local/PostgreSQL/sandbox evidence plus independent validation.
